comparison.objective: Remove an air-fryer basket from its drawer and place it on a heat-proof mat; versions use either a slide-under-hooks release or a held release button.
comparison.physical_skill: Keyed basket release, handle lifting, transport and placement while avoiding hot surfaces; the later version coordinates holding a button while lifting.
comparison.success_condition: Basket released, placed flat and still on the mat, button returned where applicable, robot clear, with hot contact, bypass lifting or dropping causing zero. No material rubric detail is missing.
comparison.reason: The candidate tests concentric driver-and-wrench countertorque that preserves a gripper stop setting through jam-nut locking and repeated actuation, not keyed release and safe transport of a hot basket.
